systems.system: Drone strikes on power plants and power outages

SDN.note: Outages mentioned with no count or frequency.

facts.fact: The Emergency Telecommunication Cluster says it manages and expands connectivity from a dedicated 1G undersea cable providing fibre connectivity to multiple locations in Sudan.

SDN.note: Nothing on cuts or punishment for speech; the February 2025 operator outage is put down to bombardment, not an order.

facts.fact: ETC coordinator Richard Egwangu says the authorities in Port Sudan continue to prohibit importing and using Starlink devices in the western parts of the country.
